_note: Act II: the crisis, the low point. Frames. Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres. {SLOT:feature} requires a feature (see frames.py); verbs bind to the subject and object around them; {was}/{is} agree with the noun before.
entries: Alone at {landmark}, {first} faced {FEELING} and {VICE} at once.
{the_someone:human} took {the_thing}, and {first} had nothing left to bargain with.
{the_disaster:strikes} came back {MANNER}, and {CLOSE:human} paid for {first}'s choices.
